experimentalBuild.name: Armored spellblade duelist

experimentalBuild.testObjective: Count Bravado pairs, Q heals and E casts over a 12-second melee fight, recording mana used.
failureConditions: Ranged opponents deny the attacks that recycle spells.
Magic damage punishes the armor-heavy core.

profile.name: Taric

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A ranged attrition and trap controller who pressures attacks with blind, disengages with speed and denies paths with mushrooms.
kitEvidence: Toxic Shot poisons basic attacks
Blinding Dart denies attacks
Noxious Trap slows and damages pathing enemies
strengths: Prepared trap zones reveal and slow opponents
constraints: Fragile against spell burst
Traps can be detected or avoided

experimentalBuild.name: Speed-blind bruiser
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Blade of the Ruined King and Stormrazor emphasize basic attacks and brief movement bursts, while Navori aims to return blind sooner through attacks. This shifts damage away from AP traps and toward contact-dependent dueling, with Toxic Shot's current bonus-AD ratios a secondary contribution.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure blind uptime, attacks landed and damage during a 12-second chase.
failureConditions: Spell-heavy enemies ignore blind
Weaker traps cannot deter objective entry

profile.name: Teemo

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A catch-and-peel controller who hooks enemies, adjusts spacing with Flay and offers allies a lantern escape while souls grow defenses and AP.
kitEvidence: Death Sentence can pull Thresh to a hooked target; Dark Passage transports an ally.
Flay's attack damage charges with time since the last attack; Damnation grants armor and AP.
constraints: Hooks can hit unwanted units
Rapid attacks spend Flay's charged opening

experimentalBuild.name: Charged-chain attacker
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Rapid Firecannon helps deliver an energized opening while Lich Bane rewards a preceding cast and Nashor supports follow-up attacks. The core explicitly trades Flay's fully charged attacks for more sustained item damage; souls are not treated as free scaling AD.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Compare one fully charged Flay attack with a four-second attack sequence at fixed souls.
failureConditions: Faster attacks erase too much charged Flay value
Damage spending leaves lantern duty and frontline survival weak

profile.name: Thresh

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A ranged attack carry who rapidly stacks a bomb for burst and jump resets, with growing range supporting later safety. Jumping aggressively depends on actually completing the bomb or obtaining a takedown.
kitEvidence: Explosive Charge gains damage from attack/ability stacks and crit chance.
Rapid Fire grants a large attack-speed window.
Rocket Jump refreshes on champion takedowns or full-stack champion bombs.
strengths: Strong bomb-based burst and tower threat.
constraints: Jump commitments are risky without a reset.
Bomb stacking can be denied by control or spacing.

experimentalBuild.name: AP bomb jumper
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor supplies attack speed for bomb stacks while AP strengthens documented E, W and R ratios; Lich Bane adds a cast/attack reward. This tests an AP burst combo rather than sustained crit DPS, and R should be timed so knockback does not deny needed attacks.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Compare four-stack bomb combo damage, time to detonation and reset escape success.
failureConditions: Missing AD/crit makes sustained damage inadequate.
Cannot finish bomb stacks after an aggressive jump.

profile.name: Tristana

profile.intendedPlaystyle: An attack-based duelist who fights on his frozen zone, steals defensive stats and uses a pillar to obstruct escape.
kitEvidence: Chomp steals AD through an empowered attack
Frozen Domain boosts attacks and healing
Subjugate steals health and defenses
constraints: Damage access is mainly melee
Pillar placement can also obstruct allies

experimentalBuild.name: AP subjugation troll
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor's Tooth supplies AP and attack on-hit damage while Riftmaker supports longer combat, using Subjugate's current AP ratio as an alternate damage route. Spirit Visage supports healing received alongside Frozen Domain; the cost is weaker AD-driven Chomp and ordinary attacks.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure R damage, total healing and sustained attack damage over a 10-second tank duel.
failureConditions: R is unavailable for most trades
Reduced physical damage lets opponents disengage

profile.name: Trundle

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A melee attack carry who builds Fury for crit chance, spins to maintain contact and uses temporary death immunity to extend a finishing window.
kitEvidence: Battle Fury builds critical chance through attacks and kills.
Spinning Slash cooldown falls with critical strikes; Bloodlust spends Fury to heal.
constraints: Control can consume his entire ultimate window
Healing spends the Fury supporting crit

experimentalBuild.name: AP spinning recovery
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: AP supports both the listed Spinning Slash damage and Bloodlust healing, while Nashor and Lich Bane add attack-based magic damage after spins. This tests recoverable short trades, sacrificing normal AD crit pressure and requiring a fixed-Fury comparison.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure spin damage, Q healing and attack damage separately at fixed Fury.
failureConditions: Low crit frequency delays repeat spins
Opponents survive the magic burst and deny basic attacks

profile.name: Tryndamere

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A ranged pick-and-roam mage who selects a card for control or mana, then uses map vision and teleport to create numbers advantages. His attack cadence also produces periodic Stacked Deck damage.
kitEvidence: Pick a Card offers mana restoration, area slow or stun.
Stacked Deck grants attack speed and a fourth-hit magic proc.
Destiny reveals enemies and permits a long-range teleport.
constraints: No dash in ordinary fights.
Card selection and arrival placement can be punished.

experimentalBuild.name: Deck sustained hybrid
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor and Rageblade support sustained attacks with mixed stats, while Terminus builds mixed penetration through champion attacks. Stacked Deck's exact interaction with phantom on-hits must be tested; the documented fourth-attack cadence is not assumed to accelerate independently.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure card, Stacked Deck and item damage separately across eight seconds of uninterrupted attacks.
failureConditions: Low burst cannot convert a Gold Card pick.
Teleport positioning exposes him before penetration stacks build.

profile.name: Twisted Fate

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A stealth ambusher who builds poison before Contaminate and uses extended-range piercing attacks to pressure aligned enemies.
kitEvidence: Ambush grants camouflage and post-exit attack speed
Deadly Venom stacks true damage
Contaminate damages poisoned enemies
constraints: Fragile if detected before entry
Damage needs poison stacks or sustained attacks

experimentalBuild.name: Poison-and-pounce AP hybrid
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor's Tooth helps build poison through basic attacks while Gunblade contributes both damage stats and a slowing active. Deathcap emphasizes the current AP poison and Contaminate ratios, testing stack burst rather than conventional physical ultimate damage.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure time to six poison stacks and E-plus-poison damage during a 6-second ambush.
failureConditions: Burst arrives before stacks accumulate
Weak physical attacks underperform after E is spent

profile.name: Twitch

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A stance-based melee fighter who alternates two empowered attacks with movement, shielding or storm damage and chooses where to spend Awaken.
kitEvidence: Monk Training gives post-cast attack speed and reduces Awaken cooldown on attacks.
Wilding Claw enhances attacks; Blazing Stampede provides a target-gated stun and awakened control immunity.
constraints: Must enter melee attack range
Awaken spent on offense is unavailable for defense

experimentalBuild.name: Mixed on-hit claw fighter
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor and Rageblade increase ordinary attack on-hit contribution while Udyr's stance cadence keeps attack windows active; Visage supports Mantle healing and shields. This does not assume Rageblade repeats limited next-two-attack effects or isolated awakened lightning.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Record normal on-hit damage and Awaken cooldown recovery across four stance swaps.
failureConditions: Too little health and armor to complete attack pairs
Enemy grouping reduces isolated lightning value

profile.name: Udyr

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A short-range juggernaut who circles enemies to fire fresh leg cannons and converts a low-health target into an execute and area fear. Purge provides fixed-rate moving attacks rather than a normal attack-speed steroid.
kitEvidence: Echoing Flames fires directional leg cannons with separate cooldowns.
Purge fires three times per second and slows Urgot's movement.
Fear Beyond Death executes a marked champion below its health threshold.
constraints: Positioning must expose different legs.
Short reach and Purge movement penalty invite kiting.

experimentalBuild.name: Ultimate-tempo legs
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Hexplate tests post-R movement and durability while Bloodmail and Cleaver support AD physical output. Hexplate's attack speed is not assumed to raise Purge above its documented three attacks per second, so its wasted stat cost is part of the experiment.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure legs fired, time to execute threshold and survival during eight seconds after R launch.
failureConditions: Attack-speed value is wasted without useful normal attacks.
Opponents kite before the execute threshold is reached.

profile.name: Urgot

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A mixed-damage ranged fighter who alternates attack-built Blight with charged detonations and spreading root setup.
kitEvidence: Blighted Quiver applies stacks detonated by spells
Piercing Arrow charges for stronger damage and detonation
Chain of Corruption spreads roots and applies Blight
constraints: No dash for defensive recovery
Charging Q slows his movement

experimentalBuild.name: Root-first AP artillery
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Malignance emphasizes AP-scaling root damage, Nashor's Tooth supports attack-built Blight, and Cryptbloom adds magic penetration and takedown healing. This tests ultimate into detonation rather than maximum physical poke; attack speed mostly improves stack application.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure R-to-Q detonation damage and time to reapply three stacks against a durable target.
failureConditions: R misses or is unavailable
Cannot enter attack range for a second detonation

profile.name: Varus

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A mobile single-target marksman who repeatedly attacks one target for Silver Bolts, using tumble and terrain knockback to preserve contact.
kitEvidence: Silver Bolts triggers on every third consecutive attack or ability against one enemy.
Final Hour adds AD, improves pursuit and grants tumble invisibility; Condemn stuns against terrain.
constraints: Switching targets breaks bolt cadence
Limited wave and area damage

experimentalBuild.name: Armored tumble duelist
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Blade of the Ruined King and Terminus support repeated attacks, while Iceborn adds armor and a cast-then-attack slow to help keep one target nearby. The slow and on-hit items mostly support attack access; they do not increase Silver Bolts' true damage through penetration.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure bolt procs and damage taken during a ten-second physical melee duel.
failureConditions: Magic burst bypasses armor emphasis
Defensive purchase delays enough attack speed to secure kills

profile.name: Vayne

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A scaling burst mage who earns AP through spell hits and takedowns while using a cage to restrict movement. The cage creates a landing window for delayed W and a missing-health finisher.
kitEvidence: Phenomenal Evil permanently grants AP from champion spell hits and takedowns.
Event Horizon stuns enemies crossing its boundary.
Dark Matter has a delay and stack-linked cooldown reduction.
strengths: Area zoning and powerful low-health finish.
constraints: No mobility in the collected kit.
Cage placement and W accuracy determine reliable damage.

experimentalBuild.name: Stack-supported tank mage
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Rod retains AP and mana while Frozen Heart and Abyssal test surviving long enough to use accumulated passive AP. Grasp is a risky attack-trade experiment rather than a farming proc; ranged adjustments and exact value need validation.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: At fixed passive stacks, compare damage, survival and second-rotation access in a 10-second duel.
failureConditions: Short range required by Abyssal exposes him.
Reduced AP/penetration cannot finish after cage control.

profile.name: Veigar

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A geometric artillery mage who combines spell hits to trigger true damage, then channels a beam from a protected angle.
kitEvidence: Plasma Fission splits at right angles
Organic Deconstruction triggers after three spell stacks
Disintegration Ray gains true damage against researched targets
constraints: Beam channel exposes him
No dash to repair poor positioning

experimentalBuild.name: Durable research platform
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Rod of Ages and Cosmic Drive test safer repeated stack application through health, mana and movement. Zhonya's provides a defensive pause after or before a beam, not simultaneous beam casting, sacrificing penetration-heavy burst for survival.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure completed passive triggers and uninterrupted beam time across five diver-pressure trials.
failureConditions: Low damage cannot deter approach
Stasis delays rather than solves a persistent dive

profile.name: Vel'Koz

profile.intendedPlaystyle: An anti-mobility burst mage who holds periodic fear to interrupt engages, consumes dash-generated marks and follows kills through R resets.
kitEvidence: Doom causes the next basic ability to fear and stop dashes.
Gloom marks nearby dashes; Shadow Surge can reset after its marked target dies.
constraints: Fear must be available at the right moment
R commitment relies on target access and survival

experimentalBuild.name: Armored fear diver
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Riftmaker and Abyssal Mask test prolonged close-range magic damage after an R entry, while Zhonya protects between cooldowns. Aftershock needs an actual immobilization from fear, so this core must time Doom rather than assume every R grants defenses.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure fear-triggered defensive uptime and survival after R into two opponents.
failureConditions: Doom was spent before entry
Lower burst prevents the takedown needed for R reset

profile.name: Vex

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A melee diver who isolates a target through charged Q or targeted R and follows with attacks to shred armor. Ability hits trigger her shield, making cast timing relevant to survival.
kitEvidence: Denting Blows rewards every third attack with max-health damage and armor removal.
Relentless Force empowers an attack and damages behind the target.
Cease and Desist targets a champion with an unstoppable dash/knockup.
strengths: Attack cycling combines damage and shielding support.
constraints: Committed dives can isolate her from allies.
Q charge and attack access can be disrupted.

experimentalBuild.name: AP punch laboratory
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Relentless Force currently lists an AP ratio, so Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test AP-backed E attacks while preserving attack speed for W. Riftmaker adds sustained-combat durability, but missing bonus AD weakens Q/R and W's damage scaling.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Separate E damage, W triggers and total survival during an eight-second R engage.
failureConditions: Q/R damage loss prevents reaching a finishing threshold.
Dies before repeated E attacks compensate for low AD.

profile.name: Vi

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A melee reset fighter who seeks a first takedown, uses mist for approach and temporarily adopts a fallen enemy's tools.
kitEvidence: Blade of the Ruined King gives double strikes after ability hits
Harrowed Path grants camouflage and attack speed
Sovereign's Domination swaps to victim abilities and items
strengths: Takedowns create new damage and mobility options
constraints: Needs a first eligible corpse
Possession changes his available kit and inventory

experimentalBuild.name: AP mist assassin
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor's Tooth and Gunblade support attacks while adding AP for Spectral Maw and possession healing, and Zhonya's protects an attempted first reset. The hypothesis concerns his own form; possessed inventories replace his core and must be evaluated separately.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure W burst, own-form healing and first-possession rate during five 8-second skirmishes.
failureConditions: Reduced AD prevents the first kill
Possession removes the intended item pattern

profile.name: Viego

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A scaling control mage who earns ability augments, uses shielded Q attacks to trade and controls paths through laser, gravity field and a following storm.
kitEvidence: Siphon Power shields and empowers the next attack; its upgrade adds movement speed.
Hex Fragments unlock augments; upgraded Arcane Storm grows and extends on eligible deaths.
constraints: Upgrades require fragment income
Gravity Field stun needs enemies to remain inside

experimentalBuild.name: Q attack battlemage
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor and Lich Bane strengthen the attack after Q, while Riftmaker rewards staying in combat through later attacks and spells. Press the Attack tests whether three attacks are safely available; one empowered Q attack alone cannot activate it.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Count successful three-attack windows and Q shield uptime against a melee opponent.
failureConditions: Opponent leaves after the first Q attack
Attack investment reduces safer long-range laser damage

profile.name: Viktor

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A health/AP-converting sustain mage who times empowered Q and a charged area burst, using Pool to avoid retaliation. His health costs make offensive and defensive timing inseparable.
kitEvidence: Crimson Pact converts bonus health and AP without recursive self-stacking.
Transfusion has a stronger heal/damage cast after two uses.
Tides of Blood costs health; Sanguine Pool grants temporary untargetability.
constraints: No hard control in the collected kit.
Health costs and low reach expose failed entries.

experimentalBuild.name: Drain tank bloodmage
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Riftmaker supports extended combat while Visage amplifies self-healing and Unending Despair rewards staying near champions. Bonus health contributes through Crimson Pact, but its conversion is not an infinite feedback loop and lower AP reduces burst.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure health spent/recovered, empowered Q uses and damage in a 15-second melee-range fight.
failureConditions: Enemy burst or healing reduction wins before sustain develops.
Low movement and range prevent maintaining aura contact.

profile.name: Vladimir

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A pursuing melee bruiser who stuns to set up a delayed shield zone and stays on one marked target for healing.
kitEvidence: Thundering Smash empowers a stun attack
Frenzied Maul heals on repeat marked-target casts
Sky Splitter grants a shield if he stands in the blast
constraints: Target switching loses W healing setup
E shield needs correct timing and position

experimentalBuild.name: Lightning cooldown bear
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor's Tooth supports AP-scaled passive lightning and Navori tests attack-driven W and E cooldown progress. Spirit Visage supports healing and shields received, testing repeat rotations rather than claiming extra attacks themselves trigger the marked W heal.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Count second W casts, E shields and damage in a 12-second single-target duel.
failureConditions: Target disengages before repeat W
Low armor makes attack uptime unsafe

profile.name: Volibear

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A chase-and-recovery duelist who follows weakened targets, uses Q to stay attached through movement and converts close damage into healing.
kitEvidence: Eternal Hunger heals through attacks at low health.
Jaws of the Beast follows movement when held; Primal Howl reduces damage before fearing.
constraints: Healing requires dealing damage
Control and wounds threaten low-health survival

experimentalBuild.name: AP bite skirmisher
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: AP supports the listed Q and passive ratios, Nashor adds attack on-hit damage, and Riftmaker plus Spirit Visage seek longer healing-driven exchanges. This invests less AD into R and requires live damage and healing checks rather than assuming a guaranteed low-health reversal.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure Q damage, passive healing and survival through an eight-second low-health duel.
failureConditions: Anti-heal or control prevents recovery
AP investment leaves R and attack physical damage insufficient

profile.name: Warwick

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A melee skirmisher who combines clone deception with armor-shredding attacks and two area knockup spins. Repeated hits stack defensive regeneration and recycle Q.
kitEvidence: Stone Skin stacks armor and health regeneration during champion/monster hits.
Crushing Blow shreds armor and cooldown falls from Wukong or clone hits.
Cyclone can be cast twice; Warrior Trickster creates a damaging clone.
strengths: Multi-target disruption with two R casts.
Clone and repeated attacks support extended exchanges.
constraints: Clone is stationary.
Magic burst bypasses much of the armor emphasis.

experimentalBuild.name: Nimbus hybrid monkey
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: AP strengthens Nimbus Strike's documented ratio, while Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward Wukong's own follow-up attacks. Riftmaker tests a longer magic-assisted duel, with no assumption that clone attacks copy item on-hits; low AD also reduces Q/R threat.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Separate E, own attacks and clone damage during eight-second combos.
failureConditions: Low AD makes Cyclone and Q ineffective.
Enemy magic burst prevents extended attack weaving.

profile.name: Wukong

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A ranged attacker who lays feather lines, threatens return-path roots and uses untargetability to survive an enemy commit.
kitEvidence: Clean Cuts leaves feathers after spells
Bladecaller roots when enough feathers connect
Featherstorm becomes untargetable and deposits feathers
constraints: Root depends on return angles
Short-range attack access can be contested

experimentalBuild.name: Feather dive bruiser
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Hexplate and Fiendhunter Bolts reward the attack window after Featherstorm while Black Cleaver supports repeated physical damage and adds health. This tests survival against divers with fewer standard critical items; bonus attacks are not assumed to create feathers outside Clean Cuts charges.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Record post-R attacks, feathers recalled and survival over five diver engagements.
failureConditions: Lower critical scaling weakens E damage
Enemy waits out ultimate buffs before re-engaging

profile.name: Xayah

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A long-range artillery mage who charges beams, slows targets into skillshots and uses successive ultimate shots to finish from safety.
kitEvidence: Arcanopulse gains range through a self-slowing charge.
Shocking Orb stun improves with travel distance; Mana Surge requires periodic attacks for mana.
constraints: No listed mobility escape
Most damage needs accurate skillshots

experimentalBuild.name: Team artillery spotter
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Horizon Focus reveals enemies hit from range, while Mandate marks a target immobilized by E and Shurelya helps allies follow the catch. This tests information and team access over maximum personal burst; W's slow alone does not satisfy current Mandate.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Count E-generated Mandate marks and allied follow-ups within four seconds across ten catches.
failureConditions: Frontline absorbs E before priority targets
Utility spending loses too much personal damage

profile.name: Xerath

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A melee duelist who connects W to extend his challenge-based approach and cycles three attacks into knockup and healing. R isolates the challenged target while excluding distant damage.
kitEvidence: Three Talon Strike's third attack knocks up and attacks reduce other cooldowns.
Wind Becomes Lightning marks challenged targets and has an AP ratio.
Determination triggers damage/healing; Crescent Guard blocks damage from outside its sweep.
strengths: R can protect against distant follow-up.
constraints: Cannot freely leave a committed melee fight.
Passive healing expressions are partly unresolved.

experimentalBuild.name: AP challenge duelist
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor and Dusk and Dawn support attacks while AP contributes to documented W, E, R and Determination damage. Riftmaker supports extended contact, but the unresolved healing expression prevents a precise claim about AP healing strength.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure Q knockups, spell/attack damage and observed healing over a 10-second R-isolated duel.
failureConditions: Lower AD makes Q attacks too weak.
Enemies enter R's protected radius and overwhelm him.

profile.name: Xin Zhao

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A mobile melee critical fighter who uses enemy units as dash routes, builds a knockup and punishes airborne targets.
kitEvidence: Steel Tempest builds a ranged knockup
Sweeping Blade has a per-target restriction
Wind Wall blocks projectiles
strengths: Critical and airborne synergies aid sustained combat
constraints: Dash routes depend on available targets
Approach can be punished by non-projectile control

experimentalBuild.name: AP dash-route skirmisher
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor's Tooth and Gunblade add AP for Sweeping Blade plus attack damage, while Riftmaker rewards extended combat. This tests multi-unit dash damage and mixed attack pressure, sacrificing the critical core that supports much of his normal damage.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure E damage, attacks and total damage through five distinct targets during a 10-second skirmish.
failureConditions: Few valid dash targets deny the experiment
Missing critical chance weakens Q and R follow-up

profile.name: Yasuo

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A melee attack skirmisher who builds a knock-up through Q, takes temporary spirit-form trades and returns after amplifying his attack and ability damage.
kitEvidence: Soul Unbound repeats a portion of attack and ability damage before returning.
Way of the Hunter increases crit chance and splits every second attack; Spirit Cleave grants a shield.
constraints: Spirit-form return point is predictable
Long commitment is vulnerable to control

experimentalBuild.name: On-hit resistance swordsman
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Blade of the Ruined King and Terminus emphasize repeated attacks while Jak'Sho tests surviving long enough to stack defensive benefits. This core gives up crit multiplication and does not assume Soul Unbound records every item proc in its repeated damage.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure E-window attack damage, item-proc contribution and return survival separately.
failureConditions: Crit loss weakens Q and basic-attack burst
Damage or control prevents resistance ramp before return

profile.name: Yone

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A summon-led side-lane fighter who prepares graves, marks a target for his walkers and traps escape routes. Maiden coordination and his own empowered attack create sustained pressure.
kitEvidence: Last Rites creates graves and raises Mist Walkers.
Mourning Mist marks targets, reduces armor and directs walker leaps.
Maiden has bonus-health scaling and marks targets for added damage.
strengths: Wall and mark can force awkward movement.
constraints: Damage drops without walkers or Maiden.
Wall can be destroyed or bypassed.

experimentalBuild.name: Health-fed siege keeper
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Bloodmail uses bonus health for AD, which supports the documented walker and Maiden AD ratios; Titanic and Hullbreaker primarily reward Yorick's own attacks and siege pressure. Summons are not assumed to inherit either item's on-hit effects.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: At fixed walker count, compare summon damage, own Q damage and tower pressure separately.
failureConditions: Enemy clears summons before they deliver damage.
Low resistance makes grouped fights too dangerous.

profile.name: Yorick

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A ranged attack carry who accumulates access to an empowered attack window and uses transformation for upgraded mobility and spell options.
kitEvidence: Cultivation of Spirit grants attack speed and on-hit damage
Critical strikes gain bonus magic damage
Transcend One's Self upgrades basic abilities
strengths: Transformation adds a dash and stronger spell options
constraints: Empowered windows require resource or ultimate access
Ordinary form has less escape flexibility

experimentalBuild.name: Critical spirit hybrid
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor's Tooth emphasizes current AP on-hit scaling while Yun Tal retains critical chance for her passive. Fiendhunter Bolts supports post-transformation attacks, testing a hybrid critical route without treating attack spread as guaranteed duplication of every on-hit effect.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure magic versus physical damage and empowered attack count over a 10-second R window.
failureConditions: Reduced AD hurts ordinary attacks
Item effects do not propagate through spread as hoped

profile.name: Yunara

profile.intendedPlaystyle: An attached protector who follows an ally, manages Best Friend bonuses and combines guided poke with shield, attack-speed support and healing waves.
kitEvidence: You and Me! follows an ally and grants untargetability except against towers.
Zoomies gives attached shields and attack speed; Final Chapter slows enemies and heals allies.
constraints: Movement decisions depend on her host
Immobilization while detached locks attachment

experimentalBuild.name: AP guided artillery
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Luden adds an offensive Q focus and Malignance tests ground burn from R waves, while Staff preserves ally buffs through E and R protection. AP supports the listed spell ratios, but this route spends less on dedicated heal and shield power.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure Q damage, R ground-burn contribution and host protection across one full skirmish.
failureConditions: Host movement causes missed Qs or R waves
Damage spending lets the host die before protection recovers

profile.name: Yuumi

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A sustained melee fighter who builds Determination through repeated champion hits and uses healing/control to reach its empowered state. Edge placement on E and timing R's damage reduction improve his fighting window.
kitEvidence: Cultivation of War stacks champion hits to increased AD and a conditional revive.
Darkin Glaive empowers two attack stages with healing then knockup.
Aureate Rush rewards its edge; Grim Deliverance reduces damage during casting and heals from damage.
strengths: Repeated hits unlock a major fighting payoff.
constraints: Revive requires full Determination and its cooldown.
Passive AD/revive magnitudes are unresolved.

experimentalBuild.name: Health-backed Determination
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Bloodmail adds AD from health, Sundered Sky rewards an opening champion attack and Visage amplifies self-healing. This tests whether durability permits reaching full stacks without assuming Q's double slash counts as a particular number of item or passive triggers.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Record time to full Determination, healing and revive eligibility in a 12-second duel.
failureConditions: Burst kills him before the stack requirement.
Healing reduction makes the lower-penetration core inefficient.

profile.name: Zaahen

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A healing engage tank who enters from terrain, repeatedly disrupts nearby enemies and recovers through collected blobs.
kitEvidence: Elastic Slingshot charges a long approach
Unstable Matter cooldown falls when Goo is absorbed
Cell Division heals through blobs and offers a revive
constraints: Blob collection can be contested
Charged entry can be interrupted or anticipated

experimentalBuild.name: AP blob battlemage
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Rocketbelt supplies AP and an extra movement tool while Riftmaker rewards extended combat. Bloodletter's Curse tests repeated magic-damage resistance reduction during blob-driven W cycles, trading tank resistance for higher sustained spell pressure.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure W casts, Goo pickups and damage during a 12-second two-target fight.
failureConditions: Enemies deny Goo and healing
Lower resistances cause death before damage ramps

profile.name: Zac

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A shadow-based assassin who lines up overlapping shurikens, uses swaps for positioning and concentrates damage inside Death Mark's timed window.
kitEvidence: Living Shadow restores energy when Zed and a shadow hit with the same ability.
Death Mark repeats damage after a delay; Zed's own E hits reduce W cooldown.
constraints: Energy depends on overlapping hits
Death Mark window can be denied by defense or escape

experimentalBuild.name: Sustained shadow bruiser
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Cleaver and Shojin support repeated physical ability damage and basic-cooldown access, while Sundered Sky adds value when Zed commits an attack. The hypothesis trades lethality burst for a second rotation; exact Death Mark inclusion of item damage still requires validation.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Record shuriken overlaps, energy refunds and rotations completed in a ten-second duel.
failureConditions: Less burst lets the marked target escape
No safe attack window wastes Sundered Sky

profile.name: Zed

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A mobile ranged attack carry whose Q is treated as an attack and whose ordinary attack is treated as an ability. Wall travel and sustained R hits create an escalating movement window.
kitEvidence: Burst Fire is explicitly treated as an attack.
Living Battery's charged attack is treated as an ability.
Spark Surge crosses terrain and enables piercing Q; Lightning Crash extends through champion hits.
strengths: Terrain crossing creates unusual approach and escape routes.
constraints: Q can be blocked by the first enemy.
Different attack classifications complicate item interactions.

experimentalBuild.name: Bruiser burst-fire runner
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Hexplate supports the R attack/movement window while Cleaver and Titanic test durable physical Q pressure. Q's attack classification is grounded in the source, but Titanic application across seven rounds is not assumed to multiply and must be measured.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure Q/item damage, armor reduction and R uptime over eight seconds against a blocking frontline.
failureConditions: Loss of crit reduces both damage and R stack growth.
Q blockage prevents reaching the chosen target.

profile.name: Zeri

profile.intendedPlaystyle: An artillery siege mage who combines ranged explosives with periodic empowered attacks and turret execution.
kitEvidence: Short Fuse empowers attacks and refreshes through casts
Satchel Charge displaces and executes low-health turrets
Minefield slows approaches
strengths: Long-range damage can support distant fights
constraints: Bombs can be dodged
Approaching to attack exposes an immobile caster

experimentalBuild.name: Short-Fuse attack siege
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor's Tooth adds attack pressure and Lich Bane accompanies post-cast Short Fuse attacks, while Cosmic Drive supports retreat after magic damage. This tests a spell-and-attack siege pattern; attack speed does not itself reduce Short Fuse's cooldown.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Compare turret damage in a 10-second spell-and-attack cycle and safe attacks landed against a defending champion.
failureConditions: Defender denies attack range
Lost mana budget restricts repeated spell cycles

profile.name: Ziggs

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A tempo-control mage who sets double-bomb stuns, repeatedly alters movement speed and prevents one ally death through a timed revive.
kitEvidence: A second Time Bomb detonates the first and stuns in the explosion.
Rewind reduces basic cooldowns; Chronoshift revives a target that would die during its window.
constraints: Bombs can attach to unintended units
Revive timing can be baited or waited out

experimentalBuild.name: Bomb-attack time duelist
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Time Warp can help Zilean land attacks after a bomb cast, and Nashor plus Lich Bane add damage during that window. Cosmic Drive supports spacing after magic damage, but his abilities do not provide an innate attack-damage ratio or an attack reset.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure Q-W-Q-plus-attacks damage and safe attacks within a double-bomb stun.
failureConditions: Closing to attack range exposes him to burst
Attack investment leaves insufficient bomb or revive strength

profile.name: Zilean

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A ranged pick mage who uses terrain-extended sleep and long-travel Q for burst, then returns from a brief portal. Spell shards offer opportunistic movement and damage rather than a guaranteed loadout.
kitEvidence: Paddle Star damage increases with distance traveled.
Sleepy Trouble Bubble extends through terrain and enables amplified wake-up damage.
More Sparkles empowers an attack after casting; Portal Jump returns after one second.
strengths: Portal gives a temporary cast/attack angle.
constraints: Portal return position is predictable.
Attacks can wake sleep before the intended Q hit.

experimentalBuild.name: Sparkle attack jumper
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Nashor and Lich Bane emphasize post-cast attacks while Rapid Firecannon tests a safer energized attack angle. This supports attacks rather than Q range or damage directly, and an early attack can consume sleep's wake-up opportunity.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Compare portal attack reach and total combo damage, testing Q-first and attack-first wake-ups separately.
failureConditions: Lower AP makes long-travel Q insufficient.
Extra attacks waste sleep or expose the fixed return position.

profile.name: Zoe

profile.intendedPlaystyle: A plant-based zone mage who prepares seeds, roots entry paths and strengthens a garden with a delayed knockup.
kitEvidence: Seeds become ranged or slowing plants from Q or E
Grasping Roots roots in a line
Stranglethorns enrages plants and later knocks up
constraints: Plants and seeds can be removed
Limited mobility when enemies bypass the garden

experimentalBuild.name: Garden utility conductor
experimentalBuild.hypothesis: Mandate supports root and knockup catches while Bandlepipes offers team attack speed from control effects, and Locket protects nearby allies. This tests an escort garden, with no assumption that allied attack-speed buffs accelerate plant attacks.
experimentalBuild.testObjective: Measure allied buff uptime, Locket shielding and enemies controlled during five objective-entry fights.
failureConditions: Plants die before controlling space
Reduced AP makes enemies ignore the garden

runes.shortDescription: Swap Summoner Spells while out of combat. Swapping to unique Summoner Spells will increase the rate at which you can make future swaps.

Your first swap becomes available at 6 mins. 

Summoner Spells can only be swapped while out of combat. 
After using a swapped Summoner Spell you must swap 3 more times before the first can be selected again.
Smite damage increases after two Summoner Spell swaps.

runes.description:
Every 10 min gain AP or AD, adaptive.

10 min: + 8 AP or 5 AD 
20 min: + 24 AP or 14 AD
30 min: + 48 AP or 29 AD
40 min: + 80 AP or 48 AD
50 min: + 120 AP or 72 AD
60 min: + 168 AP or 101 AD
etc...

runes.description:

May you be as swift as the rushing river and agile as a startled Rift Scuttler.

runes.name: Electrocute
runes.shortDesc: Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities in 3s deals bonus adaptive damage.
runes.longDesc:
Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3s deals bonus adaptive damage.

Damage: 70 - 240 (+0.1 bonus AD, +0.05 AP) damage.
Cooldown: 20s

'We called them the Thunderlords, for to speak of their lightning was to invite disaster.'

runes.name: Dark Harvest
runes.shortDesc: Damaging a low health champion inflicts <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_AdaptiveDmg'>adaptive damage</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> and harvests a soul from the victim.
runes.longDesc:
Damaging a Champion below 50% health deals adaptive damage and harvests their soul, permanently increasing Dark Harvest's damage by 11.

Dark Harvest damage: 30 (+11 damage per soul) (+0.1 bonus AD) (+0.05 AP)
Cooldown: 35s (resets to 1.0s on takedown)

runes.name: Hail of Blades
runes.shortDesc: Gain a large amount of Attack Speed and <trueDamage>bonus true damage</trueDamage> for the first 3 attacks made against enemy champions.
runes.longDesc:
Gain 90% (60% for ranged champions) Attack Speed and bonus true damage when you attack an enemy champion for up to 3 attacks.

No more than 3s can elapse between attacks or this effect will end.

Cooldown: 10s.
On-Hit Damage: 2 - 20 (+0.12 bonus AD, +0.1 AP) damage.

Attack resets increase the attack limit by 1.
Allows you to temporarily exceed the Attack Speed limit.

runes.name: Cheap Shot
runes.shortDesc: Deal bonus true damage to enemy champions with <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_ImpairAct'>impaired movement or actions</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>.
runes.longDesc:
Damaging champions with impaired movement or actions deals 10 - 45 bonus true damage (based on level).

Cooldown: 4s
Activates on damage occurring after the impairment.

runes.name: Taste of Blood
runes.shortDesc: Heal when you damage an enemy champion.
runes.longDesc:
Heal when you damage an enemy champion.

Healing: 16-40 (+0.1 bonus AD, +0.05 AP) health (based on level)

Cooldown: 20s

runes.name: Sudden Impact
runes.shortDesc: Damaging basic attacks and abilities deal bonus true damage to enemy champions after using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or when leaving stealth.
runes.longDesc:
Damaging basic attacks and abilities deal a bonus 20 - 80 True Damage based on level to enemy champions after using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or when leaving stealth for 4s.

Cooldown: 10s

runes.name: Sixth Sense
runes.shortDesc:
On a long Cooldown, automatically sense a nearby untracked and unseen ward, tracking it for the team.

Level 11: Also reveal the ward for 10s.
runes.longDesc:
Automatically sense a nearby untracked and unseen ward, tracking it for the team.

Level 11: Also reveal the ward for 10s.

This effect has a 250 second Cooldown.

runes.name: Grisly Mementos
runes.shortDesc:
Collect 1 memento on champion takedowns, up to 18 total.

Gain 6 Trinket Haste for each collected.
runes.longDesc:
Collect 1 memento on champion takedowns, up to 18 total.

Gain 6 Trinket Haste for each collected. In game modes where vision Trinkets do not exist, instead gain 3 Summoner Spell Haste.

runes.name: Deep Ward
runes.shortDesc:
Your wards in the enemy jungle are Deep, gaining Health and Duration.

Level 9: Wards in the river are also Deep.
runes.longDesc:
Your wards in the enemy jungle are Deep. Deep wards gain +1 extra Health and +[30 - 45]s increased duration (+[45 - 150]s for Trinket stealth wards).

Level 9: Wards in the river are also Deep.

runes.name: Treasure Hunter
runes.shortDesc: Unique takedowns grant additional gold the first time they are collected.
runes.longDesc:
Gain an additional 50 gold the next time you collect a Bounty Hunter stack. Increase the gold gained by 20 gold for each Bounty Hunter stack, up to 130 gold.

Bounty Hunter stacks are earned the first time you get a takedown on each enemy champion.

runes.name: Relentless Hunter
runes.shortDesc: Unique takedowns grant permanent out of combat MS.
runes.longDesc: Gain 8 Move Speed out of combat per Bounty Hunter stack. Bounty Hunter stacks are earned the first time you get a takedown on each enemy champion.

runes.name: Ultimate Hunter
runes.shortDesc: Unique takedowns grant permanent cooldown reduction on your Ultimate.
runes.longDesc: Your ultimate gains 6 Ability Haste, plus an additional 5 Ability Haste per Bounty Hunter stack. Bounty Hunter stacks are earned the first time you get a takedown on each enemy champion.

runes.name: Glacial Augment
runes.shortDesc: Immobilizing an enemy champion will cause 3 glacial rays that slow nearby enemies and reduce their damage to your allies.
runes.longDesc:
Immobilizing an enemy champion will cause 3 glacial rays to emanate from them towards you and other nearby champions, creating frozen zones for 3 (+ the immobilizing effect's duration) seconds that slow enemies for 20% (+90% per 100% Heal and Shield Power) (+6% per 100 Ability Power) (+7% per 100 bonus Attack Damage) and reduce their damage by 15% against your allies (not including yourself).

Cooldown: 25s

runes.name: Unsealed Spellbook
runes.shortDesc: Swap Summoner Spells while out of combat. Swapping to unique Summoner Spells will increase the rate at which you can make future swaps.
runes.longDesc:
Swap one of your equipped Summoner Spells to a new, single use Summoner Spell. Each unique Summoner Spell you swap to permanently decreases your swap cooldown by 25s (initial swap cooldown is @f3@ seconds).

Your first swap becomes available at 6 mins.

Summoner Spells can only be swapped while out of combat.
After using a swapped Summoner Spell you must swap 3 more times before the first can be selected again.
Smite damage increases after two Summoner Spell swaps.

runes.name: First Strike
runes.shortDesc: When you initiate champion combat, deal 7% extra damage for 3 seconds and gain gold based on damage dealt.
runes.longDesc:
Attacks or abilities against an enemy champion within 0.25s of entering champion combat grant 10 gold and First Strike for 3 seconds, causing you to deal 7% extra damage against champions, and granting 50% (35% for ranged champions) of bonus damage dealt as gold.

Cooldown: 25 - 15s

runes.name: Hextech Flashtraption
runes.shortDesc:
While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash.

Hexflash: Channel, then blink to a new location.
runes.longDesc:
While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash.

Hexflash: Channel for 2s to blink to a new location.

Cooldown: 20s. Goes on a 10s cooldown when you enter champion combat.

runes.name: Magical Footwear
runes.shortDesc: You get free boots at 12 min but you cannot buy boots before then. Each <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Takedown'>takedown</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> you get makes your boots come 45s sooner.
runes.longDesc:
You get free Slightly Magical Footwear at 12 min, but you cannot buy boots before then. For each takedown you acquire the boots 45s sooner.

Slightly Magical Footwear grants you an additional 10 Move Speed.

runes.name: Cash Back
runes.shortDesc: Get some gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.
runes.longDesc: Get 7.5% Gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.

runes.name: Triple Tonic
runes.shortDesc:
Upon reaching level 3, gain an Elixir of Avarice.
Upon reaching level 6, gain an Elixir of Force.
Upon reaching level 9, gain an Elixir of Skill.
runes.longDesc:
Upon reaching level 3, gain an Elixir of Avarice.
Upon reaching level 6, gain an Elixir of Force.
Upon reaching level 9, gain an Elixir of Skill.

runes.name: Time Warp Tonic
runes.shortDesc: Potions grant some restoration immediately.
runes.longDesc: Consuming a potion grants 40% of its health restoration immediately.

runes.name: Biscuit Delivery
runes.shortDesc: Gain a free Biscuit every 2 min, until 6 min. Consuming or selling a Biscuit permanently increases your max health and restores health.
runes.longDesc:
Biscuit Delivery: Gain a Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will every 2 mins, until 6 min.

Biscuits restore 20 + 2% of your maximum health, increased by up to 100% based on missing Health. Consuming or selling a Biscuit permanently increases your max health by 30.

runes.name: Cosmic Insight
runes.shortDesc:
+18 Summoner Spell Haste
+10 Item Haste
runes.longDesc:
+18 Summoner Spell Haste
+10 Item Haste

runes.name: Approach Velocity
runes.shortDesc: Bonus <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_MS'>MS</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> towards nearby enemy champions that are <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_ImpairMov'>movement impaired</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>, increased for enemy champions that you impair.
runes.longDesc:
Gain 7.5% Move Speed towards nearby enemy champions that are movement impaired. This bonus is increased to 15% Move Speed for any enemy champion that you impair.

Activation Range for CC from allies: 1000

runes.name: Jack Of All Trades
runes.shortDesc:
For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste.

Gain bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks.
runes.longDesc:
For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste.

Gain 8 or 20 bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks, respectively.

runes.name: Press the Attack
runes.shortDesc: Hitting an enemy champion 3 consecutive times deals bonus damage and amplifies your damage until you leave combat with champions.
runes.longDesc: Hitting an enemy champion with 3 consecutive basic attacks deals 40 - 160 bonus <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_AdaptiveDmg'><font color='#48C4B7'>adaptive damage</font></lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> (based on level) and amplifies your damage dealt by 8% until you leave combat with champions.

runes.name: Lethal Tempo
runes.shortDesc: Attacking an enemy champion grants you Attack Speed, up to 6 stacks. At max stacks, deal <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_AdaptiveDmg'><font color='#48C4B7'>bonus adaptive damage</font></lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> On-Attack.
runes.longDesc: Attacking an enemy champion grants you [6% Melee || 4% Ranged] Attack Speed for 6 seconds, up to 6. At max stacks, deal [9 - 30 Melee || 6 - 24 Ranged] <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_AdaptiveDmg'>bonus adaptive damage On-Attack, increased by 1% per 1% Bonus Attack Speed</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>.

runes.name: Fleet Footwork
runes.shortDesc: Attacking and moving builds Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack heals you and grants increased <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_MS'>MS</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>.
runes.longDesc:
Attacking and moving builds Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack is Energized

Energized attacks heal you for 15 - 160 (+0.1 Bonus AD, +0.05 AP) and grant 20% Move Speed for 1s.

For Ranged Champions, Healing is 60% effective and Move Speed is 75% effective. All healing is 15% effective against Minions.

runes.name: Conqueror
runes.shortDesc: Gain stacks of adaptive force when attacking enemy champions. After reaching 12 stacks, heal for a portion of damage you deal to champions.
runes.longDesc:
Basic attacks or spells that deal damage to an enemy champion grant 2 stacks of Conqueror for 5s, gaining 1.8-4 Adaptive Force per stack. Stacks up to 12 times. Ranged champions gain only 1 stack per basic attack.

When fully stacked, heal for 8% of the damage you deal to champions (5% for ranged champions).

runes.name: Absorb Life
runes.shortDesc: Killing a target heals you.
runes.longDesc: Killing a target heals you for @HealAmount@.

runes.name: Triumph
runes.shortDesc: <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Takedown'>Takedowns</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> restore 5% of your missing health and grant an additional 20 gold.
runes.longDesc:
Takedowns restore 5% of your missing health, 2.5% of your max health, and grant an additional 20 gold.


'The most dangerous game brings the greatest glory.'
—Noxian Reckoner

runes.name: Presence of Mind
runes.shortDesc: Restore a small amount of mana or energy when damaging an enemy champion. Takedowns restore mana or energy.
runes.longDesc:
Damaging an enemy champion restores 6-50 (80% for ranged) mana or 6 energy.

Takedowns restore 15% of your maximum mana or energy.

Cooldown for damage restoration: 8s

runes.name: Legend: Alacrity
runes.shortDesc: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Attack Speed.
runes.longDesc:
Gain 3% attack speed plus an additional 1.5% for every Legend stack (max 10 stacks).

Earn progress toward Legend stacks for every champion takedown, epic monster takedown, large monster kill, and minion kill.

runes.name: Legend: Haste
runes.shortDesc: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Basic Ability Haste.
runes.longDesc:
Gain 1.5 basic ability haste for every Legend stack (max 10 stacks).

Earn progress toward Legend stacks for every champion takedown, epic monster takedown, large monster kill, and minion kill.

runes.name: Legend: Bloodline
runes.shortDesc: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Life Steal, up to a cap. Once the cap is reached, increase your max health. Weaker earlier but stronger later game than other Legend Runes.
runes.longDesc:
Gain 0.45% Life Steal for every Legend stack (max 15 stacks). At maximum Legend stacks, gain 85 max health.

Earn progress toward Legend stacks for every champion takedown, epic monster takedown, large monster kill, and minion kill.

runes.name: Coup de Grace
runes.shortDesc: Deal more damage to low health enemy champions.
runes.longDesc: Deal 8% more damage to champions who have less than 40% health.

runes.name: Cut Down
runes.shortDesc: Deal more damage to high health enemy champions.
runes.longDesc: Deal 8% more damage to champions who have more than 60% health.

runes.name: Last Stand
runes.shortDesc: Deal more damage to champions while you are low on health.
runes.longDesc: Deal 5% - 11% increased damage to champions while you are below 60% health. Max damage gained at 30% health.

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying
runes.shortDesc: Every 4s your next attack on a champion deals bonus magic damage, heals you, and permanently increases your health.
runes.longDesc:
Every 4s in combat, your next basic attack on a champion will:
  • Deal bonus magic damage equal to 3.5% of your max health
  • Heal you for 1.3% of your max health
  • Permanently increase your health by 5
    Ranged Champions: Damage, healing, and permanent health gained are 40% effective.

runes.name: Aftershock
runes.shortDesc: After <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Immobilize'>immobilizing</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> an enemy champion gain defenses and later deal a burst of magic damage around you.
runes.longDesc:
After immobilizing an enemy champion, increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 45 + 75% of your Bonus Resists for 2.5s. Then explode, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

Damage: 25 - 120 (+8% of your bonus health)
Cooldown: 20s

Resistance bonus from Aftershock capped at: 80-150 (based on level)

runes.name: Guardian
runes.shortDesc: Guard allies you cast spells on and those that are very nearby. If you or a guarded ally would take damage based on level, you're both granted a shield.
runes.longDesc:
Guard allies within 350 units of you, and allies you target with spells for 2.5s. While Guarding, if you or the ally take more than a small amount of damage over the duration of the Guard, both of you gain a shield for 1.5s.

Cooldown: 75 - 40 seconds
Shield: 40 - 150 + 20% of your ability power + 6% of your bonus health
Proc Threshold: 50 - 165 postmitigation damage

runes.name: Demolish
runes.shortDesc: Your third attack against turrets deals bonus damage.
runes.longDesc:
Your third attack against towers deals [85 (+28% max Health) Melee || 50 (+20% max Health) Ranged] bonus physical damage.

Cooldown: 30s

runes.name: Font of Life
runes.shortDesc: <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_ImpairMov'>Impairing</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> the movement of an enemy champion heals nearby allied champions.
runes.longDesc:
Impairing the movement of an enemy champion restores @BaseHeal@ Health to you and the lowest health nearby allied champion.

70% effect for Ranged Users.

Cooldown: 20s

runes.name: Shield Bash
runes.shortDesc: Whenever you gain a shield, your next basic attack against a champion deals bonus <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'><font color='#48C4B7'>adaptive</font></lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> damage.
runes.longDesc:
Whenever you gain a new shield, your next basic attack against a champion deals 5 - 30 (+2.5% Bonus Health) (+15.0% New Shield Amount) bonus adaptive damage.

You have up to 2s after the shield expires to use this effect.

runes.name: Conditioning
runes.shortDesc: After 12 min gain +8 Armor and +8 Magic Resist and increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 3%.
runes.longDesc: After 12 min gain +8 Armor and +8 Magic Resist and increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 3%.

runes.name: Second Wind
runes.shortDesc: After taking damage from an enemy champion heal back some missing health over time.
runes.longDesc: After taking damage from an enemy champion, heal for 4% of your missing health over 10s.

runes.name: Bone Plating
runes.shortDesc:
After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 spells or attacks you receive from them deal 30-60 (based on level) less damage.

Duration: 1.5s
Cooldown: 55s
runes.longDesc:
After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 spells or attacks you receive from them deal 30-60 (based on level) less damage.

Duration: 1.5s
Cooldown: 55s

runes.name: Overgrowth
runes.shortDesc: Gain permanent max health when minions or monsters die near you.
runes.longDesc:
Absorb life essence from monsters or enemy minions that die near you, permanently gaining 3 maximum health for every 8.

When you've absorbed 120 monsters or enemy minions, gain an additional 3.5% maximum health.

runes.name: Revitalize
runes.shortDesc:
Gain 5% Heal and Shield Power.

Heals and shields you cast or receive are 10% stronger on targets below 40% health.
runes.longDesc:
Gain 5% Heal and Shield Power.

Heals and shields you cast or receive are 10% stronger on targets below 40% health.

runes.name: Unflinching
runes.shortDesc: Gain Armor and Magic Resist when receiving crowd control.
runes.longDesc: Gain 10 Armor and Magic Resist when crowd controlled and for 2 seconds after.

runes.name: Summon Aery
runes.shortDesc: Your attacks and abilities send Aery to a target, damaging enemies or shielding allies.
runes.longDesc:
Damaging enemy champions with basic attacks or abilities sends Aery to them, dealing 10 - 50 based on level (+0.05 AP) (+0.1 bonus AD).

Empowering or protecting allies with abilities sends Aery to them, shielding them for 20 - 100 based on level (+0.05 AP) (+0.1 bonus AD).

Aery cannot be sent out again until she returns to you.

runes.name: Arcane Comet
runes.shortDesc: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a damaging comet at their location.
runes.longDesc:
Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location, dealing increased damage based on distance.

Adaptive Damage: 15 - 100 based on level (+0.05 AP and +0.1 bonus AD)
Cooldown: 20 - 8s

Damage amplification scales up to 100% at 750 range.

runes.name: Stormraider's Surge
runes.shortDesc: Dealing 25% of a champion's maximum health grants a burst of <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_MS'>MS</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> and Slow Resist.
runes.longDesc:
Dealing 25% of a champion's maximum health within 3s grants 48% Move Speed and 50% Slow Resistance for 4s. Move Speed is 75% effective for ranged champions.
Cooldown: 20s - 10s

runes.name: Deathfire Touch
runes.shortDesc: Damaging a champion with an ability burns them over time.
runes.longDesc:
Damaging a champion with an ability burns them for 3 - 12 based on level (+2.5% AP) (+7% bonus AD) magic damage per second. After burning for 3 seconds, the damage of the burn increases by 75% while they remain on fire.

Duration:
Single Target: 4s
Area of Effect: 2s
Damage over Time: 1s

runes.name: Axiom Arcanist
runes.shortDesc: Your Ultimate has increased damage, healing, and shielding. Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces your Ultimate's current cooldown.
runes.longDesc:
Your Ultimate has 12% increased damage, healing, and shielding.
(AoE damage is reduced to a 8% increase)

Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces your Ultimate's current cooldown by 7%.

runes.name: Manaflow Band
runes.shortDesc:
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently increases your maximum mana by 25, up to 250 mana.

After reaching 250 bonus mana, restore 1% of your missing mana every 5 seconds.
runes.longDesc:
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently increases your maximum mana by 25, up to 250 mana.

After reaching 250 bonus mana, restore 1% of your missing mana every 5 seconds.

Cooldown: 15 seconds

runes.name: Nimbus Cloak
runes.shortDesc: After casting a Summoner Spell, gain a short <speed>Move Speed</speed> increase that allows you to pass through units.
runes.longDesc:
After casting a Summoner Spell, gain a Move Speed increase that lasts for 2s and allows you to pass through units.

Increase: 15% - 45% Move Speed based on the Summoner Spell's cooldown. (Higher cooldown Summoner Spells grant more Move Speed).

runes.name: Transcendence
runes.shortDesc:
Gain bonuses upon reaching the following levels:
Level 5: +5 Ability Haste
Level 8: +5 Ability Haste
Level 11: On Champion takedown, reduce the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 20%.
runes.longDesc:
Gain bonuses upon reaching the following levels:
Level 5: +5 Ability Haste
Level 8: +5 Ability Haste
Level 11: On Champion takedown, reduce the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 20%.

runes.name: Celerity
runes.shortDesc: All <speed>Move Speed</speed> bonuses are 7% more effective on you and gain <speed>1% Move Speed</speed>.
runes.longDesc: All movement bonuses are 7% more effective on you and gain <speed>1% Move Speed</speed>.

runes.name: Absolute Focus
runes.shortDesc: While above 70% health, gain extra <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_AdaptiveDmg'>adaptive damage</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword>.
runes.longDesc:
While above 70% health, gain an adaptive bonus of up to 18 Attack Damage or 30 Ability Power (based on level).

Grants 1.8 Attack Damage or 3 Ability Power at level 1.

runes.name: Scorch
runes.shortDesc: Your first damaging ability hit every 10s burns champions.
runes.longDesc:
Your next damaging ability hit sets champions on fire dealing 20 - 40 bonus magic damage based on level after 1s.

Cooldown: 10s

runes.name: Waterwalking
runes.shortDesc: Gain <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_MS'>MS</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> and AP or AD, <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'>adaptive</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> in the river.
runes.longDesc:
Gain 10 Move Speed and 13 - 30 Adaptive Force (based on level) when in the river.

May you be as swift as the rushing river and agile as a startled Rift Scuttler.

runes.name: Gathering Storm
runes.shortDesc: Gain increasing amounts of AD or AP, <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'>adaptive</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> over the course of the game.
runes.longDesc:
Every 10 min gain AP or AD, adaptive.

10 min: + 8 AP or 5 AD
20 min: + 24 AP or 14 AD
30 min: + 48 AP or 29 AD
40 min: + 80 AP or 48 AD
50 min: + 120 AP or 72 AD
60 min: + 168 AP or 101 AD
etc...
